sharedRules.name: Milan Mount
sharedRules.description: A unit with a Transport Attachment with Milan Mount may remove Milan Missile Teams before th game, mounting a Milan Missile on one of the Unit's Transport Teams for each team they removed.

sharedRules.name: Autoloader
sharedRules.description: When a weapon with an Autoloader fires an Artillery Bombardment reduce the score required To Hit Teams under the Template by 1.

sharedRules.name: Sneak and Peek
sharedRules.description: A Tank with Sneak and Peek can move 10" / 25cm at Tactical Speed if it is not firing its main gun.
